content.comment_body: There is a [product_name] module ([article_no]) and a [company_name] [product_name] OPC server. Can their parameters be adjusted so that VM Mapping is available for reading and writing data to a SCADA system from a different manufacturer?
Please check the attachment, especially the information on page 107.

Maybe my question was unclear. I want to find out if it is possible to configure the [product_name] OPC Server for data transfer to a SCADA system, and if so, what steps are required for this configuration?

Hello, The [product_name] OPC is a standard OPC server and communicates with any standard OPC client. There should be no issues using SCADA systems from other providers through OPC. Best regards, [user_name]
I see, thanks. My question is about how to set up [product_name] so that it can work with the [product_name] module using the OPC server.
Add a connection in [product_name] Net, specifically in Rack 0, Slot 2. You should be able to access the V area by referencing it as DB1. Best regards, [user_name]

Apologies, I failed to mention I am working with [product_name] [version_no]. I also understand how things work with [product_name] [version_no]. Thank you for the information. It looks like I need to update the license to [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: The user is working on integrating a [product_name] module with a [company_name] OPC server in order to exchange data with a SCADA system from another manufacturer. The main challenge is configuring the OPC server to connect properly to the [product_name] module, with particular attention to version differences, licensing requirements, and mapping OPC data for third-party SCADA compatibility. The user finds the available documentation or setup instructions lacking for this scenario.
analysis.user_expectations: User seeks straightforward configuration of the OPC server for reliable data communication between the [product_name] module and third-party SCADA systems, including clear setup guidelines and compatibility across product versions.
